blocks.title: Enable Event delivery for {organization}
blocks.purpose: Lets Ever Platform send signed notifications (for example 'your plan changed') to installations that can receive them. Installations that only make outbound connections use polling instead.

platform_keeps.retention: Kept while the integration is enabled.

blocks.where_to_change: Integrations & data in this product, or Instances in app.ever.co; turning it off stops the data at once.
blocks.revoke_effect: The endpoint is deleted. The installation falls back to polling.
blocks.authorisation: I am authorised to enable this for {organization}
